def: Shual, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine

occurrences.text: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah, unto the land of Shual:
The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
